description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'PolicyTooManyModifyingRequestsException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. The class represents an error scenario where too many concurrent requests are made to a specific policy, preventing further modifications. It includes static factory methods for creating instances from message strings or JSON objects, a builder pattern for constructing exception objects, and metadata such as error codes and descriptions.

classes.name: PolicyTooManyModifyingRequestsException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating excessive concurrent requests to a policy, preventing further modifications. Extends DittoRuntimeException and implements PolicyException. Provides static factory methods, constants for error code and messages, and a nested builder class for flexible instantiation.
